text_en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt:
text_cn: 上主在埃及国训示梅瑟和亚郎说：

text_en: This month shall mark for you the beginning of months; it shall be the first month of the year for you.
text_cn: “你们要以本月为你们的正月，为你们算是一年的首月。

text_en: Tell the whole congregation of Israel that on the tenth of this month they are to take a lamb for each family, a lamb for each household.
text_cn: 你们应训示以色列会众，本月十日，他们每人照家族准备一只羔羊，一家一只。

text_en: If a household is too small for a whole lamb, it shall join its closest neighbor in obtaining one; the lamb shall be divided in proportion to the number of people who eat of it.
text_cn: 若是小家庭，吃不了一只，家长应和附近的邻居按照人数共同预备，并照每人的饭量估计当吃的羔羊。

text_en: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a year-old male; you may take it from the sheep or from the goats.
text_cn: 羔羊应是一岁无残疾的公羊，要由绵羊或山羊中挑选。

text_en: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of this month; then the whole assembled congregation of Israel shall slaughter it at twilight.
text_cn: 把这羔羊留到本月十四日，在黄昏的时候，以色列全体会众便将它宰杀。

text_en: They shall take some of the blood and put it on the two doorposts and the lintel of the houses in which they eat it.
text_cn: 各家都应取些血涂在吃羔羊的房屋的两门框和门楣上。

text_en: They shall eat the lamb that same night; they shall eat it roasted over the fire with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
text_cn: 在那一夜要吃肉；肉要用火烤了，同无酵饼及苦菜一起吃。

text_en: Do not eat any of it raw or boiled in water, but roasted over the fire, with its head, legs, and inner organs.
text_cn: 肉切不可吃生的或水煮的，只许吃火烤的。头、腿和五脏都应吃尽。

text_en: You shall let none of it remain until the morning; anything that remains until the morning you shall burn.
text_cn: 一点也不许留到早晨；若是早晨还有剩下的，都要用火烧掉。

text_en: This is how you shall eat it: your loins girded, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it hurriedly. It is the passover of the Lord .
text_cn: 你们应这样吃：束着腰，脚上穿着鞋，手里拿着棍杖，急速快吃：这是向上主守的逾越节。

text_en: For I will pass through the land of Egypt that night, and I will strike down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, both human beings and animals; on all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 这一夜我要走遍埃及国，将埃及国一切首生，无论是人是牲畜都要杀死，对于埃及的众神，我也要严加惩罚：我是上主。

text_en: The blood shall be a sign for you on the houses where you live: when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague shall destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 这血在你们所住的房屋上，当作你们的记号：我打击埃及国的时候，一见这血，就越过你们去，毁灭的灾祸不落在你们身上。

text_en: This day shall be a day of remembrance for you. You shall celebrate it as a festival to the Lord ; throughout your generations you shall observe it as a perpetual ordinance.
text_cn: 这一天将是你们的纪念日，要当作上主的节日来庆祝；你们要世世代代过这节日，作为永远的法规。

text_en: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; on the first day you shall remove leaven from your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day shall be cut off from Israel.
text_cn: 你们应一连七天吃无酵饼。第一天务要从你们家内将酵子除去，因为从第一天直到第七天，凡吃有酵之物的人，都应从以色列中铲除。

text_en: On the first day you shall hold a solemn assembly, and on the seventh day a solemn assembly; no work shall be done on those days; only what everyone must eat, that alone may be prepared by you.
text_cn: 第一天和第七天应召开圣会；这两天一切劳工都不可作，只准你们准备每人吃的东西。

text_en: You shall observe the festival of unleavened bread, for on this very day I brought your companies out of the land of Egypt: you shall observe this day throughout your generations as a perpetual ordinance.
text_cn: 你们应守无酵节，因为这一天我领你们的军旅出离了埃及国，所以你们要世世代代守这一天，作为永远的法规。

text_en: In the first month, from the evening of the fourteenth day until the evening of the twenty-first day, you shall eat unleavened bread.
text_cn: 从正月十四日晚起，到二十一日晚为止，你们应吃无酵饼。

text_en: For seven days no leaven shall be found in your houses; for whoever eats what is leavened shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether an alien or a native of the land.
text_cn: 七天内，在你们的家内不准有酵子，因为凡吃了有酵之物的，不论他是外方人或是本地人，都应从以色列会众内铲除。

text_en: You shall eat nothing leavened; in all your settlements you shall eat unleavened bread.
text_cn: 任何有酵之物，不准你们吃；在你们所居住之处，都应吃无酵饼。”

text_en: Then Moses called all the elders of Israel and said to them, “Go, select lambs for your families, and slaughter the passover lamb.
text_cn: 梅瑟召集了以色列众长老来，向他们说：“你们去为你们的家属准备一只羊，宰杀作逾越节羔羊。

text_en: Take a bunch of hyssop, dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and touch the lintel and the two doorposts with the blood in the basin. None of you shall go outside the door of your house until morning.
text_cn: 拿一束牛膝草蘸在盆中血里，用盆中的血，涂在门楣和两旁的门框上；你们中谁也不准离开自己的房门，直到早晨。

text_en: For the Lord will pass through to strike down the Egyptians; when he sees the blood on the lintel and on the two doorposts, the Lord will pass over that door and will not allow the destroyer to enter your houses to strike you down.
text_cn: 因为上主要经过，击杀埃及人；他一见门楣和两门框上有血，就越过门口，不容毁灭者进你们的房屋。

text_en: You shall observe this rite as a perpetual ordinance for you and your children.
text_cn: 你们应遵守这规定，作为你们子孙的永远法规。

text_en: When you come to the land that the Lord will give you, as he has promised, you shall keep this observance.
text_cn: 日后你们到了上主许给你们的地方，应守这礼。

text_en: And when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this observance? ’
text_cn: 将来你们的子孙若问你们这礼有什么意思，

text_en: you shall say, ‘It is the passover sacrifice to the Lord , for he passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt, when he struck down the Egyptians but spared our houses. ’” And the people bowed down and worshiped.
text_cn: 你们应回答说：这是献于上主的逾越节祭：当上主击杀埃及人的时候，越过了在埃及的以色列子民的房屋，救了我们各家。”于是百姓都屈膝朝拜。

text_en: The Israelites went and did just as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron.
text_cn: 以色列子民就去奉行了。上主怎样吩咐了梅瑟和亚郎，他们就怎样作了。

text_en: At midnight the Lord struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the prisoner who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of the livestock.
text_cn: 那天半夜，上主击杀了埃及所有的长子，从坐宝座的法郎的长子，直到坐监者的长子，以及一切头胎牲畜。

text_en: Pharaoh arose in the night, he and all his officials and all the Egyptians; and there was a loud cry in Egypt, for there was not a house without someone dead.
text_cn: 在这一夜，法郎，他所有的臣仆和全埃及人都起来；在埃及发生了大哀号，因为没有一家不死人的。

text_en: Then he summoned Moses and Aaron in the night, and said, “Rise up, go away from my people, both you and the Israelites! Go, worship the Lord , as you said.
text_cn: 夜间法郎召梅瑟和亚郎来说：“你们和以色列子民都起身离开我的百姓走吧！照你们所要求的，去崇拜上主吧！

text_en: Take your flocks and your herds, as you said, and be gone. And bring a blessing on me too! ”
text_cn: 也照你们所要求的，带着你们的羊群牛群去吧！也为我求祝福。”

text_en: The Egyptians urged the people to hasten their departure from the land, for they said, “We shall all be dead. ”
text_cn: 埃及人催迫这百姓赶快离开此地，因为他们说：“我们快要死尽！”

text_en: So the people took their dough before it was leavened, with their kneading bowls wrapped up in their cloaks on their shoulders.
text_cn: 百姓便把没有发酵的面团和面盆包在外衣内，背在肩上。

text_en: The Israelites had done as Moses told them; they had asked the Egyptians for jewelry of silver and gold, and for clothing,
text_cn: 以色列子民也照梅瑟所吩咐的作了，向埃及人要求金银之物和衣服。

text_en: and the Lord had given the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. And so they plundered the Egyptians.
text_cn: 上主使百姓在埃及人眼中蒙恩，给了他们所要求的；他们这样劫夺了埃及人。

text_en: The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides children.
text_cn: 以色列子民从辣默色斯起程向稣苛特进发。步行的男子约六十万，家属不算在内。

text_en: A mixed crowd also went up with them, and livestock in great numbers, both flocks and herds.
text_cn: 同他们一起走的，还有很多外族人，也带着自己的羊群、牛群和大批的牲畜。

text_en: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough that they had brought out of Egypt; it was not leavened, because they were driven out of Egypt and could not wait, nor had they prepared any provisions for themselves.
text_cn: 他们把从埃及带出来的未发酵的面团烤成无酵饼，因为他们急迫离开埃及，不能耽搁，来不及准备行粮。

text_en: The time that the Israelites had lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.
text_cn: 以色列子民居留埃及共有四百三十年。

text_en: At the end of four hundred thirty years, on that very day, all the companies of the Lord went out from the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 四百三十年届满的那一天，上主的军旅离开了埃及。

text_en: That was for the Lord a night of vigil, to bring them out of the land of Egypt. That same night is a vigil to be kept for the Lord by all the Israelites throughout their generations.
text_cn: 这一夜是上主领他们出离埃及所守的一夜，这一夜也是以色列子民世世代代向上主当守的一夜。

text_en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron: This is the ordinance for the passover: no foreigner shall eat of it,
text_cn: 上主向梅瑟和亚郎说：“有关逾越节祭餐的法规如下：任何外方人不准参加这祭餐。

text_en: but any slave who has been purchased may eat of it after he has been circumcised;
text_cn: 凡用钱买来的奴隶，受过割损礼后，方可参加。

text_en: no bound or hired servant may eat of it.
text_cn: 旅客和佣工不得参加。

text_en: It shall be eaten in one house; you shall not take any of the animal outside the house, and you shall not break any of its bones.
text_cn: 应在同一间房屋内吃尽，不可将肉块带到屋外，也不可将骨头折断。

text_en: The whole congregation of Israel shall celebrate it.
text_cn: 以色列全会众都应举行此祭餐。

text_en: If an alien who resides with you wants to celebrate the passover to the Lord , all his males shall be circumcised; then he may draw near to celebrate it; he shall be regarded as a native of the land. But no uncircumcised person shall eat of it;
text_cn: 若有同你在一起居住的外方人，愿向上主举行逾越节祭餐，他家所有的男子应受割损礼，然后才准前来举行，如本地人一样；但未受割损礼的人决不许参加。

text_en: there shall be one law for the native and for the alien who resides among you.
text_cn: 本地人和住在你们中间的外方人同属一例。”

text_en: All the Israelites did just as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron.
text_cn: 全以色列子民就都奉行了。上主怎样吩咐了梅瑟和亚郎，他们就怎样作了。

text_en: That very day the Lord brought the Israelites out of the land of Egypt, company by company.
text_cn: 就在这一天，上主将以色列子民一队一队地领出了埃及。
